title: Lost ACK -> authoritative physical-state reconciliation -> bounded compensation
purpose: Reference scenario for external-effect observability semantics; not a proposed OpenTelemetry schema.

attempts.rule: transport failure must not be rewritten as physical effect failure

required_semantic_distinctions: logical effect identity vs attempt identity
dispatch/transport evidence vs authoritative effect evidence
transport failure vs unresolved physical effect
compensation requested vs compensation physically verified
fresh measured state as the origin for the next decision
nonclaims: This file does not define OpenTelemetry attribute names.
This file does not require physical-specific GenAI semantic conventions.
This file is a sanitized reference scenario for evaluating generic external-effect semantics.
